name: hcapp_listDevices
description: Everything that can get into the calling hasher's account (E9.F7.S19): every HC.Device row owned by the token's user, with whether it holds a passkey and whether it has been signed out. Read-only. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 121, @param NULL); @userId comes from the token and the query is scoped to it — no caller-supplied user. No 'active in the last N days' cut-off: a row leaves the list only when it is both signed out (removed = 1) and holds no passkey. Supersedes hcapp_listPasskeys for new clients; that SP stays for builds 1390/1391.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then fails gracefully). Also used to flag IsThisDevice.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) returns the error detail alone and the SP returns.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success: emitted before the query runs.

rowsets.name: Devices
rowsets.description: One row per device, most recent sign-in first. WHERE d.UserId = @userId AND (d.removed = 0 OR d.PasskeyCredentialId IS NOT NULL).

columns.name: Label
columns.description: '<OperatingSystem or Harrier Central/Browser> on <platform>' — built from Device.OperatingSystem, IsMobile and HC6.DevicePlatformName(DeviceData).

columns.name: IsThisDevice
columns.description: 1 when the row is the calling @deviceId.

columns.name: AppVersion
columns.description: Device.Version as of the last sign-in; NULL when blank (564 rows platform-wide).

columns.name: AppBuild
columns.description: Device.BuildNumber as of the last sign-in; NULL when blank.

columns.name: HasPasskey
columns.description: 1 when Device.PasskeyCredentialId is set. The credential id and public key never leave the server.

columns.name: IsSignedOut
columns.description: 1 when Device.SignedOutAt is set — deliberately NOT from `removed`, which 300 legacy rows carry without meaning.

sideEffects: None on success. INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW on an unhandled error.

codeSmells.issue: Success envelope emitted before the query
codeSmells.detail: Line 62 sends {success:1} before the SELECT at line 64. If the query fails, the CATCH logs and re-raises, so the client receives a success envelope followed by an HTTP 500.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
